# NEXUS AI

NEXUS is an AI companion interface for creators, learners, builders, and curious minds.

## Public pages
- / — product overview and interactive landing page
- /features — core product capabilities
- /models — AI companion modes
- /pricing — pricing UI and tier descriptions
- /about — project and design principles
- /chat — interactive chat experience

## Product
NEXUS emphasizes conversation, coding, learning, productivity, open model support, and a terminal-inspired interface.
